grains.RAW.PROGRAMMES: one row per distribution programme (one programme type run in one Indonesian city)
grains.RAW.PROGRAMME_DAILY: one row per programme per day (90 days); beneficiary data aggregate only
grains.RAW.PROGRAMME_DOCUMENTS: one row per programme (programme file document snapshot)
grains.RAW.DONOR_CHANNEL_DAILY: one row per donor channel per day (90 days)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.escalation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(a disbursement delay on the programme is escalated to programme review in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day organisation-wide delay-volume FORECAST; bank transfer rejection rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.DISBURSEMENT_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic disbursement delay handling SOPs (one per programme type and delay reason)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.ZAKAT_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.ZAKAT_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, programme, delay-reason, risk and donor-channel rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (programmes, daily delay cases, escalations by programme, escalation risk, disbursement events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_DISBURSEMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_DELAY_ALERT logs new DELAYED disbursements to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
